call_questions: What is contribution margin per store per month, and same-store sales growth for your oldest stores?
How many store owners have left the network, and why?
At what store density per town does supply break even?
What did you learn in the stores that changed the product?
Supply chain in small towns is where this breaks - tell us about the worst supply failure so far and what you changed.
what_would_change_our_view: Same-store sales growth and positive store-level contribution margin on the earliest stores, with store-owner retention data.
